<script lang="ts">
	import { setCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	import type { CompCtxProps } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	let { open = $bindable(false), onOpenChange, side = "bottom", align = "start", sideOffset = 4, size = "lg", rounded = "2xl", children }: Props = $props();
	const baseId = $props.id();
	const contextData: Omit<CompCtxProps, "open"> = $derived({ baseId, side, align, sideOffset, size, rounded, onOpenChange });
	const ctx = setCompCtx({ ...contextData, open });

	// Keep the shared settings in sync when the props change.
	$effect.pre(() => void Object.assign(ctx, contextData));

	// Keep the bindable prop and the shared open state in sync in both directions.
	$effect.pre(() => void (ctx.open = open));
	$effect.pre(() => void (open = ctx.open));
</script>

<!-- Trigger and content parts; the content places itself beside the registered trigger. -->
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { CheckIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import MenuItem from "./menu-item.svelte";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { CheckboxItemProps } from "./index.js";
	let { checked = $bindable(false), onCheckedChange, disabled = false, closeOnSelect = false, children, class: className, ...props }: CheckboxItemProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();

	/** Toggles the item and reports the change, then closes the menu if the item asks to. */
	const handleSelect = () => {
		checked = !checked;
		onCheckedChange?.(checked);
		if (closeOnSelect) ctx.close();
	};
</script>

<!-- Checkbox item with a check mark while checked. -->
<MenuItem class={className} role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked={checked} data-state={checked ? "checked" : "unchecked"} {disabled} onSelect={handleSelect} {...props}>
	{#snippet indicator()}
		{#if checked}
			<CheckIcon />
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
	{@render children()}
</MenuItem>

<script lang="ts">
	import Menu from "./menu.svelte";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ContentProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: ContentProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
</script>

<!-- Top-level menu, placed beside the trigger while open. -->
<Menu class={className} id={ctx.contentId} aria-labelledby={ctx.triggerId} open={ctx.open} anchor={ctx.triggerEl} side={ctx.side} align={ctx.align} sideOffset={ctx.sideOffset} initialFocus={ctx.initialFocus} onDismiss={() => ctx.setOpen(false)} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</Menu>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import MenuItem from "./menu-item.svelte";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ItemProps } from "./index.js";
	const { disabled = false, variant = "default", inset = false, closeOnSelect = true, onSelect, children, class: className, ...props }: ItemProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();

	/** Runs the item's action, then closes the menu unless the item keeps it open. */
	const handleSelect = () => {
		onSelect?.();
		if (closeOnSelect) ctx.close();
	};
</script>

<!-- Item that runs an action. -->
<MenuItem class={className} role="menuitem" {disabled} {variant} {inset} onSelect={handleSelect} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</MenuItem>
{@render children()}
{#if indicator} {@render indicator()} {/if} {@render children()} {@render trailing?.()}

{#if open}
{@render children()}
{/if}
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { CircleIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import MenuItem from "./menu-item.svelte";
	import { useCompCtx, useRadioGroupCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { RadioItemProps } from "./index.js";
	const { value, disabled = false, closeOnSelect = false, children, class: className, ...props }: RadioItemProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const radioGroup = useRadioGroupCtx();

	const isChecked = $derived(radioGroup.value === value);

	/** Checks the item in its group, then closes the menu if the item asks to. */
	const handleSelect = () => {
		radioGroup.select(value);
		if (closeOnSelect) ctx.close();
	};
</script>

<!-- Radio item with a dot while checked. -->
<MenuItem class={className} role="menuitemradio" aria-checked={isChecked} data-state={isChecked ? "checked" : "unchecked"} {disabled} onSelect={handleSelect} {...props}>
	{#snippet indicator()}
		{#if isChecked}
			<CircleIcon />
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
	{@render children()}
</MenuItem>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import Menu from "./menu.svelte";
	import { useSubCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Attachment } from "svelte/attachments";
	import type { SubContentProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: SubContentProps = $props();
	const sub = useSubCtx();
	// Gap in pixels past the sub trigger, which clears the parent menu's padding and border.
	const SIDE_OFFSET = 8;
	// Shift in pixels that lines the first item up with the sub trigger, past the padding and border.
	const ALIGN_OFFSET = -5;

	/** Keeps the submenu open once the pointer reaches it, even if it crossed another item on the way. */
	const keepOpenOnEnter: Attachment<HTMLElement> = (node) => {
		const keepOpen = () => sub.cancelClose();
		node.addEventListener("pointerenter", keepOpen);
		return () => node.removeEventListener("pointerenter", keepOpen);
	};

	/** Closes the submenu and returns focus to its sub trigger. */
	const closeToTrigger = () => {
		sub.setOpen(false);
		sub.triggerEl?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
	};
</script>

<!-- Submenu, placed beside its sub trigger while open. -->
<Menu class={className} id={sub.contentId} aria-labelledby={sub.triggerId} open={sub.open} anchor={sub.triggerEl} side="right" align="start" sideOffset={SIDE_OFFSET} alignOffset={ALIGN_OFFSET} initialFocus={sub.initialFocus} onDismiss={() => sub.setOpen(false)} onArrowLeft={closeToTrigger} {@attach keepOpenOnEnter} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</Menu>

<script lang="ts">
	import { ChevronRightIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import MenuItem from "./menu-item.svelte";
	import { useLevelCtx, useSubCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Attachment } from "svelte/attachments";
	import type { SubTriggerProps, MenuFocus } from "./index.js";
	const { disabled = false, inset = false, children, class: className, ...props }: SubTriggerProps = $props();
	const level = useLevelCtx();
	const sub = useSubCtx();

	/** Opens this submenu and closes any other submenu open at the same level. */
	const openSub = (initialFocus: MenuFocus) => {
		// If a sibling submenu is open: close it first so only one shows.
		if (level.activeSub && level.activeSub !== sub) level.activeSub.setOpen(false);
		level.activeSub = sub;
		sub.setOpen(true, initialFocus);
	};

	/** Registers the sub trigger for placement and focus, and opens the submenu on hover and keys. */
	const registerTrigger: Attachment<HTMLDivElement> = (node) => {
		sub.triggerEl = node;

		/** Opens the submenu when a mouse or pen rests on the sub trigger. */
		const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
			// If this is a touch or the item is disabled: wait for a tap instead.
			if (e.pointerType === "touch" || disabled) return;
			openSub("none");
		};
		/** Opens the submenu and focuses its first item with the right arrow, Enter, or Space. */
		const handleKeydown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
			// If the item is disabled or the key does not open: leave it to the parent menu.
			if (disabled || !["ArrowRight", "Enter", " "].includes(e.key)) return;
			// Mark the key as handled so the parent menu does not also select the item.
			e.preventDefault();
			// If the submenu is already open from hovering: move focus into it.
			if (sub.open) sub.focusFirstItem();
			else openSub("first");
		};

		// Listen on the item itself so these run before the parent menu's key handling, and before delegated prop handlers.
		node.addEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
		node.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeydown);
		return () => {
			node.removeEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
			node.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeydown);
			// If another sub trigger has not taken over: clear the reference.
			if (sub.triggerEl === node) sub.triggerEl = undefined;
		};
	};
</script>

<!-- Item that opens a submenu, with a chevron pointing toward it. -->
<MenuItem class={className} role="menuitem" id={sub.triggerId} aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={sub.open} aria-controls={sub.open ? sub.contentId : undefined} data-state={sub.open ? "open" : "closed"} {disabled} {inset} keepHighlight={sub.open} onSelect={() => openSub("none")} {@attach registerTrigger} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
	{#snippet trailing()}
		<ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" />
	{/snippet}
</MenuItem>

<script lang="ts">
	import { setSubCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { SubProps } from "./index.js";
	let { open = $bindable(false), children }: SubProps = $props();
	const baseId = $props.id();
	const ctx = setSubCtx({ open, baseId });

	// Keep the bindable prop and the shared open state in sync in both directions.
	$effect.pre(() => void (ctx.open = open));
	$effect.pre(() => void (open = ctx.open));
</script>

<!-- Sub trigger and sub content parts; the sub content places itself beside the sub trigger. -->
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { createAttachmentKey } from "svelte/attachments";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { TriggerProps, TriggerAttrs } from "./index.js";
	const { children, trigger, variant = "outline", size, rounded, class: className }: TriggerProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// One key for the life of the trigger, so the element is not re-registered on every open.
	const registerKey = createAttachmentKey();
	// Whether the menu was open when the current press started.
	let wasOpenOnPress = false;
	const triggerProps: TriggerAttrs = $derived({
		id: ctx.triggerId,
		"aria-haspopup": "menu",
		"aria-expanded": ctx.open,
		"aria-controls": ctx.open ? ctx.contentId : undefined,
		"data-state": ctx.open ? "open" : "closed",
		onpointerdown: () => (wasOpenOnPress = ctx.open),
		onclick: handleClick,
		onkeydown: handleKeydown,
		[registerKey]: registerTrigger,
	});

	// Function declarations are hoisted, so the derived props above can reference them.

	/** Registers the trigger element so the menu can be placed against it and return focus to it. */
	function registerTrigger(node: HTMLElement) {
		ctx.triggerEl = node;
		return () => {
			// If another trigger has not taken over: clear the reference.
			if (ctx.triggerEl === node) ctx.triggerEl = undefined;
		};
	}

	/** Toggles the menu on click, and on Enter and Space through the native button click. */
	function handleClick(e: MouseEvent) {
		// Keyboard clicks have no press and report a detail of 0, so a stale press is ignored.
		const isKeyboard = e.detail === 0;
		const wasOpen = wasOpenOnPress && !isKeyboard;
		wasOpenOnPress = false;
		// If the press started while open: the browser already closed the menu, so keep it closed.
		if (wasOpen || ctx.open) return ctx.setOpen(false);
		// Keyboard opens focus the first item; pointer opens focus the menu so the arrows still work.
		ctx.setOpen(true, isKeyboard ? "first" : "menu");
	}

	/** Opens the menu with the down arrow on the first item, or the up arrow on the last. */
	function handleKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
		if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
			e.preventDefault();
			ctx.setOpen(true, e.key === "ArrowDown" ? "first" : "last");
		}
	}
</script>

<!-- Render the custom trigger when given, otherwise an outline button that follows the menu size. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} size={size ?? ctx.size} {rounded} class={className} {...triggerProps}>{@render children?.()}</Button>
{/if}

description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with groups, checkbox and radio items, submenus, keyboard support, sizes, and rounded corners.
